# Mediahive AB

> Mediahive AB is an honest, practical AI partner for small and mid-sized businesses in Sweden. We build AI assistants, automation of everyday work, custom AI tools and bot-to-bot integrations, explained in plain Swedish or English. Based in Västerås; we work across Sweden, on site in Mälardalen or remotely, and internationally.

- Company: Mediahive AB, org.nr 559493-6790, Västerås, Sweden
- Founder: Kaj Nybom (AI developer, member of BNI Elit Västerås)
- Member of Företagarna Västerås (Swedish small-business association)
- Languages: Swedish, English
- Contact: kai@mediahiveab.com, +46 72 982 04 84
- Website: https://mediahiveab.com/

## Services

- AI automation of everyday work: repetitive admin, email, documents and data handled by AI with a human in control.
- AI assistants for businesses and their customers: assistants that answer, book and follow up on your channels.
- Custom AI tools and web apps built for one business's workflow.
- Bot-to-bot communication and system integration: connecting your systems and assistants so they can receive, understand and answer requests from other bots, safely and with the owner's approval.
- AI advisory and workshops: what is worth building and what to skip.

## How we work

- Starts with a short, free call; then a fixed price for a clearly scoped first step, so the cost is known before anything is built.
- No lock-in: the customer owns what is built and gets documentation to run it themselves or switch supplier.
- Plain language, no jargon.

## Products

- Referenskortet (The Referral Card): referral postcards for BNI members and other referral networks. https://referralcard.ai/

## FAQ

- Do you only work in Västerås? No. We are based in Västerås and meet customers across Mälardalen, but most work is done remotely, across Sweden and internationally, in Swedish or English.
